visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a brown hooded parka, a gray life vest, black pants, and boots stands on a gray rocky beach. He waves his right hand to the camera with a slight smile. A small black inflatable boat is docked behind him. The background features a large body of water with ice floes and snowy mountains under a cloudy sky. (2) A single penguin stands on a dark rocky outcrop, looking out towards a body of water filled with icebergs and large, snow-covered mountains in the distance. (3) A close-up of a brown seal sitting among large gray rocks; its whiskers and wet fur are clearly visible as it looks to the side. (4) A group of black and white penguins are gathered on a snowy slope; some are walking while others flap their flippers. Massive snowy peaks dominate the background. (5) A seal lies flat on its back on a pristine white snow surface, appearing to rest with its eyes closed and flippers tucked. (6) A wide shot of the deep blue ocean with a massive, flat-topped iceberg in the distance, partially covered by low-hanging gray clouds. (7) A large white and blue expedition ship, with the name "OCEAN NOVA" visible on its hull, is seen from a low angle on the water. (8) Two dark seals are on a snowy patch near rocks; one is sitting up with its mouth open as if vocalizing while the other rests nearby. (9) A tight close-up of a fuzzy gray baby penguin chick standing among rocks, looking around. (10) A whale's dark tail fluke rises high from the water and then gracefully dips back under the surface of the cold sea. (11) A penguin lies on its belly on the snow, using its flippers to push itself forward in a sliding motion directly toward the camera lens. (12) A penguin walks across rocky ground. Colorful variety-style text with a heart emoji appears at the top of the frame.
